label: The actual contingents' joint absence by withholding, under the creator reading (inference)
rule: Ground the joint absence, locate the holder in its world, and use factive giving to show it withholds each member there
meaning: P1-prime gives a holder y at w; P2-prime gives an accessible world v where every concrete being contingent at w is absent and y exists. By the creator reading y gives each of them being at w; since each is absent at v, factive giving shows y gives none of them being at v. Constructive.
